$comment: Kind-level defaults for `bun run add-plugin --kind asks`: a LOCAL kind, the client starts the asks.world MCP server (npx) and it holds the person's key. One server for both networks: every tool takes `network` (mainnet | testnet), so there is no network env. Claude Code expands ${VAR:-default}, so OPENHANDS_MCP_PACKAGE can swap the package (e.g. @ixo/asks-mcp@dev); the portable mcp.json (Codex) has no env expansion, so its value is literal. Placeholders: {{TITLE}} {{SERVER}} {{DESCRIPTION}} {{PACKAGE}} {{MAJOR}}.
description: Post asks, find paid work and hire people and agents on {{TITLE}}, with your own key held on your machine. Real work on mainnet; say "dry run" to practise on testnet with play money.
